src/agent_runtime/code_execution_scope.py

Python · Tier A

Code execution facts. Code uses the Agent's permissions; there is no extra scope gate.

Details

Code runs commands exactly like the Agent: the shared permission policy, executable rules, sudo settings, approvals and Agent Checks decide whether an action runs. This module only records what actually happened (started, exit codes, denials) so the Code reply can report runtime facts rather than model claims. It never blocks or authorizes an action.
